Review before saving: first compile of the almanac for 'Board Documents' (16 of 17 files processed; 1 failed). Proposed file: almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md in 'Board Documents/Almanac'. Current documented rules, with the source of each:

1. Monthly fee: $240 per unit since 2026-03-01 (minutes 2026-01-20, 3-0). Replaces $225 (minutes 2025-01-23). The $230 notice of 2025-02-10 was corrected by minutes 2025-04-15. The $235 proposal was amended, not adopted.
2. Pets: up to 2 pets per unit since 2025-04-15, registration required, 35-lb dog limit removed (minutes 2025-04-15, 3-0). Replaces one pet and 35 lb (bylaws 2019).
3. Renovation hours: Mon-Fri 8-5, Sat 9-1 since 2024-07-15, no Sundays or holidays (minutes 2024-06-12, 3-0; notice 2024-07-01).
4. Balconies: written approval for fixtures; barbecues prohibited (bylaws 2019). Heat pumps allowed with approval if floor-mounted, not on railing, at most 60 dB(A) (minutes 2025-01-23, 2-1).
5. Quiet hours: 10 p.m. to 7 a.m. nightly (bylaws 2019). No change.
6. Rentals: minimum lease 30 days since 2025-04-15 (minutes 2025-04-15, 2-1). Replaces six months. A 7-day lease proposal failed 1-2.
7. Parking: guest parking up to 48 hours since 2025-10-01 (minutes 2025-09-10, 3-0). Replaces 72 hours.
8. EV chargers: allowed in assigned spaces with written approval, licensed electrician, owner's cost (minutes 2026-01-20, 3-0).
9. Pool hours, 2026 season: CONFLICT. Minutes 2025-09-10 say 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.; the notice of 2026-05-01 says 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. Not resolved by any document.
10. Landscaping contract (Bramblewick): ran to 2026-03-31; board decided not to renew (minutes 2025-09-10). Non-renewal notice sent 2026-02-02, after the 2026-01-30 due date. No successor vendor is recorded. Status: incomplete.
11. Officers: board of three, quorum two; Treasurer replaced by appointment 2025-09-10.
12. Governance: Part A bylaws need a two-thirds owner vote; Part B house rules need a board majority.

Provisional (from the 2026-06-18 recording, not rules): the board leans towards electric barbecues, no vote; a motion is planned for September; the secretary is to ask the insurer by the end of July.
